data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that helps you create animated counter text.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Countup widget that animates numeric values from a beginning point to an ending point over a specified duration. It supports formatting options like prefixes, suffixes, separators, and text styling.
use_when: You need to display an animated number counting up or down in your app.
You want a simple widget for animating text values without complex animation controllers.
avoid_when: You need complex graph visualizations or charts.
strengths: Easy to use with straightforward properties like begin, end, and duration.
Supports custom separators, prefixes, suffixes, and standard TextStyle options.
weaknesses: Limited to counting animations for numeric text.
Does not document advanced custom path or physics-based motion configurations.
